title: PM-invalidatable wait declarations (#4286)
intent:
Current state: #4286 implementation is GREEN and verified locally. New operation `issue.monitor.wait.invalidate` (params.number, params.reason, optional params.by) lets the PM void a wait declaration; the row keeps the declaration text plus `waiting.invalidated` {by, reason, at}, reads `waiting.in_force:false`, and returns to ordinary stuck detection from the agent's last heartbeat on the next scan. AC-3: `waiting.silent_secs` / `waiting.silent_beyond_stuck_timeout` flag a declared-but-silent row without changing the detector. Agent wait/clear path unchanged; a fresh declaration supersedes an invalidation but never resets the cap anchor.

Reason: the declaring agent was the only party able to end a wait; the PM ruling that removes the condition now has a lever, and the status field no longer reads as protected after expiry or invalidation.

Evidence: gwt lib 2955 passed (Windows, all-features), Windows clippy gwt+gwt-skills clean, Linux container: cfg(unix) daemon control tests 2/2 + clippy gwt all-targets clean, gwt-skills 347 passed.

Next: commit, Draft PR, verify.plan/verify.run (CI-anchored), execution.complete. Did not touch #4356's inbox row fields.
